title: Jeilani's new album “Absence of Affection” is a soulful journey through love and loss
htmlContent: Rising R&B star Jeilani has launched an exciting new chapter in his music career with his latest album, Absence of Affection, now available on all streaming platforms. This album is a heartfelt look at themes of heartbreak and healing, featuring 10 tracks that showcase Jeilani's genuine storytelling ability. Inspired by iconic artists like Usher and Summer Walker, Jeilani pours his true feelings into each song, creating a personal listening experience yet relatable to everyone. His powerful and soulful voice and heartfelt lyrics capture the emotions of love fading away, self discovery, and the quest for closure. From the sad tones of "Over...?" to the deep reflections in "Rebound," every song on Absence of Affection pulls listeners into Jeilani's journey through love, regret, and growth. The standout track, "Mistakes," sums up the album's theme. https://open.spotify.com/album/4wsu9UMYkysgcqKFG00THA "Rebound" offers a raw and intimate story that resonates long after the song ends. With a total playtime of just over 32 minutes, Absence of Affection delivers a strong message about artistry and personal growth. This release shows that R&B is about expressing genuine emotions openly and without holding back. Follow on: Instagram
